name: Costa Rican Sign Language
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

sources.citation: Retana Castro, Priscilla. 2011. Aproximación a la Lengua de Señas Costarricense (LESCO). Revista de Filología y Lingüística de la Universidad de Costa Rica 37(2): 137-146. doi:10.15517/rfl.v37i2.6427
sources.note: Nothing. pp.139-140 describe the sign-internal phonological parameters (Stokoe: handshape 'configuración manual', location, movement, realized simultaneously, 'tienen un carácter fonológico') with LESCO minimal pairs (VACA:VENADO); no mention of stress, prominence, or prosody.

sources.citation: Woodward, James. 1992. Historical bases of New Costa Rican Sign Language. Revista de Filología y Lingüística 18(1): 127-132. doi:10.15517/rfl.v18i1.20071
sources.note: Nothing; lexicostatistical comparison of NLESCO, OLESCO and ASL basic vocabulary only.

sources.citation: Retana Castro, Priscilla. 1993. Descripción del aspecto verbal en la lengua costarricense de señas. Tesis de Maestría en Lingüística, Universidad de Costa Rica, San José.

sources.note: The only extended linguistic description of LESCO (Stokoe-parameter phonology + verbal aspect); would confirm that no prominence/stress category is posited. Low value for a word-stress catalog since the language is signed.

sources.citation: Woodward, James. 1991. Sign Language Varieties in Costa Rica. Sign Language Studies 73: 329-346.
